review.images: Aldar corporate originals provide the canal aerial and waterfront elevations. The final-phase launch supplies the apartment living room, arrival lobby and cinema. The bedroom comes from the Almira-hosted Aldar brochure physical page 26.
review.location: Aldar’s labelled map on physical page 7 shows the canal outline and the 30- and 50-minute estimates. The official corporate page identifies the Yas Island location. No precise building entrance was verified.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all ten apartment layouts on nine full pages 32–40. The first spread shows different areas for studio A and B. Retained their separate values, followed by the printed whole-layout areas for pages 33–40. The four building floorplates on pages 41–44 remain in the linked PDF. Aldar’s direct brochure URL returned HTTP 503 during review. The public Almira-hosted Aldar copy is identified as such.

unavailable: Exact building entrances and signed apartment areas.
